audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 1 and 2 read Skill / Olaf / Olaf in both layers, but the whys[] and the early[] prose say the opposite: 'Olaf throws an axe to slow and walk up while you have only one ability' (Level 1 is his), 'Your W-root into Q-knockback finally gives you a real trade' (2 is yours), 'you tax his axe pickups... for a sustain edge' (3 is yours). early[] states it outright: 'Level 1 is his... The lane swings to you at 2-3.'
audit.why: Undertow is a 1000-range slow with an armour shred; at Level 1 Maokai has one ability and no answer to being slowed and auto'd. From Level 2 Twisted Advance into Bramble Smash plus Sap Magic reverses it, and at 3 saplings deny the axe pickup that would reset Undertow's flat 9s cooldown.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1 and 2 set to Olaf / Maokai / Maokai in both layers with ratings 3/10, 6/10, 6/10. This is also the packet chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text has Olaf finishing 'Bramble Vest/Black Cleaver'. Bramble Vest is an armour and anti-heal component — it is a Maokai item, and it is not a damage spike for Olaf. Packet flagged it as a probable wrong name.
audit.why: Nothing in Olaf's kit or build path makes Bramble Vest a first-item power spike; the actual first-item spike is Black Cleaver, and what carries the trade is Undertow's slow plus Reckless Swing's true damage.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text now names Black Cleaver alone and states the two abilities by name.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ragnarok is described everywhere as flat 'CC-immune', with no mention of its condition. dontsFull[1] is titled 'W-root into his R (immune)' and then says nothing about it.
audit.why: Riot's own text: he 'can activate this ability to become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking'. The immunity is conditional on him continuing to attack — disengaging out of his 325-range Reckless Swing ends it, and then the root lands. Flat 'he is immune' teaches the player to give up on their own kit for the full duration.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d now state the attacking condition and Ragnarok's 100s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Undertow is repeatedly called 'his axe' with no cooldown, and the pickup-reset is mentioned in the prose without the number that makes denying it matter.
audit.why: Undertow is a flat 9s at every rank, and picking the axe back up fully resets it. Denying the pickup is the difference between one axe every 9 seconds and one on demand — that is the whole reason to sapling the axe.
audit.corrected: phases[2].why now carries the 9s figure tied to the pickup denial.

edits.before: Passive heal + AA trades carry the early waves. Identify how Olaf contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Undertow slows you from 1000 range and he walks up to auto — you have one ability and no combo to answer it.

edits.before: W root is your engage AND your peel — spend it once per fight. Only take the trade when Olaf's Ragnarok is down.
edits.after: W-root into Q-knockback is your first real trade, and Sap Magic heals back the chip he lands on your way out.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Olaf must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Saplings tax his axe pickups — deny them and Undertow stays a flat 9s instead of resetting, so you repeat W-Q free.

edits.before: Nature’s Grasp roots whole teams — lane it only for kill windows. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Olaf's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Ragnarok makes him immune to disables while he keeps attacking, so W root and R wall whiff — but he cannot kill you outright yet.

edits.before: CC-immune — your root won’t hold him. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: CC-immune while he keeps attacking; 100s at rank 1. Commit once it is down.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Ragnarok holds only while he keeps attacking — disengage, then root.

edits.before: Once Olaf finishes Bramble Vest/Black Cleaver his axe slow plus true damage out-DPSes your Sap Magic sustain.
edits.after: Once Olaf finishes Black Cleaver his Undertow slow plus Reckless Swing true damage out-DPSes your Sap Magic.

notes: The Bramble Vest suspectName was a REAL error, not a false positive — it is an anti-heal armour component and belongs on Maokai's build, not as an Olaf damage spike. Second real find: every mention of Ragnarok in this file called it flat CC immunity, when Riot's text conditions it on Olaf continuing to attack; a player taught 'he is immune' will hold W for the whole 100s instead of disengaging and rooting when he stops swinging. Chart rows 0-2 flipped in matched pairs to agree with the file's own early[] prose.
